about.title: About Us
paragraphs: Kindness & Care provides home support services to people experiencing loss of functionality and consequent dependence for self-care who require specialized professional assistance. The team includes healthcare professionals involved in ongoing training and working together under the leadership of a case manager. They focus on empowering family caregivers so they can carry out their role in a healthy, sustainable, and autonomous way.
We are a Spin-off of the University of Minho (UM), and our goal is to transfer the knowledge generated within the university, putting that knowledge at the service of the community.
With a team of qualified and experienced professionals, Kindness & Care provides home support services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Although Kindness & Care was originally created as a project focused on home support, the company’s strategy is based on the continuous pursuit of new market segments. We have identified health and wellness tourism as an opportunity for sustainable growth, allowing us to leverage our know-how, experience, and the high quality of our professionals to meet the care needs of tourists seeking comfort, safety, and quality of life during their stay.

In October 2025, Kindness & Care established a strategic partnership with Pousadas de Portugal, an iconic brand in Portuguese hospitality. This collaboration stems from the mutual recognition of shared values — genuine quality, care, and attention to the well-being of each person.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.subtitle: The journey of care, empathy, and purpose that gave rise to Kindness & Care

sections.title: The Moment That Changed Everything
paragraphs: At the beginning of 2025, I lost my mother. It was a moment of profound pain. A fall in 2023 left my mother with difficulty walking. From that moment on, she gradually lost functional capacity for self-care, forcing the family to seek a home support service to assist her with personal hygiene.

It was two years of relying on home support service companies (SAD), which allowed us to see, in every service we used, a care system dominated by professionals with limited technical knowledge, mechanical routines, rushed staff, little attention to my mother's emotions, and almost no concern for understanding who she still was: a woman with a story, with expectations and memories that deserved to be cared for with tenderness.

sections.title: The Frustration That Turned into Purpose
paragraphs: Seeing the lack of humanity—and even of some competence—in the daily care provided to my mother over those two years left us outraged. We could neither understand nor accept that the services offered by most companies on the market did not meet the needs and expectations of those who rely on them (clients and their families).

The frustration gave rise to a simple and urgent question: «What if it were different? What if there were a service that combined technical competence with genuine human warmth, a service with humanity?»

sections.title: Kindness & Care Is Born
paragraphs: It was that question that turned into our mission. Instead of creating just another home support company, my wife and I wanted to build a project that, while focusing on the technical competence of professionals, would put the person first.

Where each caregiver would not be just a service provider, but a companion on the journey. Where every visit would be an opportunity to truly listen to the client — to hear their stories, understand their fears and expectations, and celebrate small victories — always upholding their dignity.

sections.title: The Tribute That Inspires Our Everyday Work
paragraphs: From the spark of the idea to the creation of the company, a year and a half went by. Although Kindness & Care was not able to care for my mother, I carry her in my heart always. Every gesture of care toward each of our clients is a tribute to that look of tenderness we lost — and a commitment to ensure that other families do not experience the same feelings ours did.

cta.text: If you’re looking for a Home Support Service that combines technical expertise with genuine humanity, come talk to us. At Kindness & Care, every story matters — including yours.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How we handle and protect your data

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Kindness & Care (hereinafter "we", "our" or "the company") is committed to protecting the privacy of its clients, partners, and website visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Portuguese law.

sections.heading: 2. Data Controller
paragraphs: Kindness & Care
Email: geral@kindnesscare.pt

sections.heading: 3. Data We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect the following personal data:
list: Identification data: full name, date of birth, tax identification number (when required);
Contact data: address, phone number, email address;
Health data: relevant clinical information for service provision (only with explicit consent);
Browsing data: IP address, browser type, visited pages, visit duration (via cookies);
Billing data: information required for invoicing and payment processing.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes of Processing
paragraphs: We use your data for the following purposes:
list: Provision of home care and healthcare services;
Management of information requests and quotes;
Communication regarding appointments, service changes, and relevant information;
Compliance with legal and tax obligations;
Improvement of our services and website user experience;
Sending informational communications (only with consent).

sections.heading: 5. Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: Your personal data is processed based on the following legal bases:
list: Consent: for health data and marketing communications;
Contract execution: for the provision of contracted services;
Legal obligation: for invoicing and tax obligations;
Legitimate interest: for improving our services and website security.

sections.heading: 6. Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not share your personal data with third parties, except when necessary for service provision (such as partner healthcare entities), to comply with legal obligations, or with your explicit consent.

sections.heading: 7. Retention Period
paragraphs: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including compliance with legal obligations (notably tax obligations, for a period of 10 years) and the defense of rights in legal disputes.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
list: Right of access: to know what data we process and how;
Right to rectification: to request correction of inaccurate data;
Right to erasure: to request deletion of your data (except where law requires retention);
Right to restriction: to request limitation of processing;
Right to object: to object to processing for certain purposes;
Right to data portability: to receive data in a structured format;
Right to withdraw consent: at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.

sections.heading: 9. Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, or disclosure. Our website uses HTTPS to ensure secure data transmission.

sections.heading: 10. Cookies
paragraphs: Our website uses essential cookies for its operation. You can configure your browser to block or alert you about cookies, but some website features may become unavailable.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be published on this page with the corresponding update date. We recommend periodic consultation of this page.

sections.heading: 12. Contact and Supervisory Authority
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or about the processing of your data, contact us at geral@kindnesscare.pt.
If you believe your rights have not been respected, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) — www.cnpd.pt.
